'use client'; import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import Link from 'next/link'; import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'; import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client'; export default function VendorDashboard() { const router = useRouter(); const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('overview'); const [isRegistered, setIsRegistered] = useState(false); const [socket, setSocket] = useState(null); const [incomingRides, setIncomingRides] = useState([]); const [vendorId] = useState('driver-001'); // Mock vendor ID useEffect(() => { if (isRegistered) { const apiUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001'; const newSocket = io(apiUrl); setSocket(newSocket); newSocket.on('connect', () => { console.log('Vendor connected to WebSocket'); newSocket.emit('driver_online', { driverId: vendorId }); }); newSocket.on('new_ride_request', (ride) => { console.log('New ride received:', ride); setIncomingRides(prev => [...prev, ride]); }); return () => { newSocket.disconnect(); }; } }, [isRegistered, vendorId]); const acceptRide = (bookingId: string) => { if (socket) { socket.emit('accept_ride', { bookingId, driverId: vendorId }); // Listen for success or failure just for this booking socket.once('ride_accepted_success', (confirmedBooking) => { alert('You successfully accepted the ride!'); setIncomingRides(prev => prev.filter(r => r.id !== bookingId)); }); socket.once('ride_accepted_failed', (data) => { alert('Failed to accept: ' + data.message); setIncomingRides(prev => prev.filter(r => r.id !== bookingId)); }); } }; return (
